meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你调试 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的缺陷：先复现问题，写失败测试，再实现最小修复并验证。它还会按目标仓库不同，把修复交付为 PR（针对上游 Codex）或带补丁的 issue（针对 LazyCodex 相关仓库）。
howto.when: 当你说要修 bug、贡献修复、给 bug 开 PR 等，或要求调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修一下 LazyCodex 的 bug，它导入时报错。
say.note: Claude 会开始复现并定位问题。

say.text: 给 openai/codex 的这个 bug 写个修复 PR。
say.note: Claude 会在分叉仓库实现修复并创建 PR。

say.text: 把 LazyCodex 的缺陷修复整理成 issue 并附上补丁。

howto.what_en: Installs so Claude can debug LazyCodex/Codex defects: reproduce, add failing test, implement minimal fix, verify. Delivers a fork PR for openai/codex, or a verified-fix issue with patch for LazyCodex repos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Help fix this LazyCodex bug: it errors on import.
Write a fix PR for this openai/codex bug.
say_en.note: Claude implements fix in a fork and creates PR.

say_en.text: Create a verified-fix issue with patch for this LazyCodex defect.
say_en.note: Claude generates issue with embedded diff.
